displayName: [Preview]: Cognitive Services Agents should only use allowed control
description: Mandate minimum levels of multi-severity content filtering for harmful content for agents within your organization.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
List of allowed entity kinds for agents. Only agents with an entity kind in this list will be evaluated by the policy.

List of Enabled Configuration for Prompt. When the value is a list of true, only agents with enabled field configured as true can be allowed. When the value is a list false, only agents with enabled field configured as false can be allowed. When the value is a list true and false, fields where Enabled is configured as true or false are allowed

List of Blocking Configuration for Prompt. When the value is a list of true, only agents with blocking field configured as true can be allowed. When the value is a list false, only agents with blocking field configured as false can be allowed. When the value is a list true and false, fields where Blocking is configured as true or false are allowed
